schinese.title: 神圣巴蜀帝国 Holy Bashu Empire
schinese.description:
[h1]七圈三十六府，蜀地新百年[/h1]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10089394321281458581/F83AA0978D2C5F5CDC9951FA112EC7774E21A0AB/[/img]

至元末年，蜀地连绵的春雨冲断了北面的栈道。成都府收到的第一封急报，却是汉州的一纸诉状：上游新修的渠堰截住了水，下游的春耕已不能再等。

三十六府的使者于是齐聚锦江。盐商带来账册，关吏呈上欠粮，茶马行首把磨旧的马铃放在案头。各府重订旧盟，推举共主，划分七圈。

帝国的印玺留在成都，钱粮、商路与兵役却仍须逐府议定。盟约落印的第二天，汉州的使者仍站在府衙门前，等着上游放水。

属于蜀地的新百年，就从这一桩尚未办妥的水案开始。

[h2]山川之间，择一府而治[/h2]

七个帝国圈，三十六个可选府州诸侯，合计164个地块。
你可以经营锦江两岸的田亩，也可以掌管川南井灶，守住北面的关道，或让茶马商队穿过山门。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/9902154446628851737/2EA1F6F45E7F761231D2AF9AEC918457A14FDAEE/[/img]

[list]
[*][b]巴蜀史实风物。[/b] 都江堰岁修治水、文翁石室兴学、蜀锦织造、宋代卓筒盐井与茶马互市，写入地方背景、事件和课题；山城、蜀道与川江故事各有地理出处。唯帝国与「七圈」政制，是一场立足于巴蜀山川的架空推演。
[*][b]百年地方经营。[/b] 特色革新、风味事件与国家决议，围绕各圈产业、民生与军制展开，故事随历次抉择延续，直至分支收束与结局回顾。
[*][b]机构与军伍。[/b] 地区建筑、特色产业生产方式、9种特色兵种，把作坊、官学、仓廪和守备纳入本府经营。
[*][b]山川合治。[/b] 占领并控制核心地区，可在国家内容的「可成立」页查看蜀、渝与巴蜀帝国，亦可经国家决议成立；三套新旗帜相随，原府革新与议约继续沿用。特色兵军制各有长处，革新依前置课题与实践推进。
[/list]

[h2]名产出蜀，百业相生[/h2]

[quote=]
锦户讲习院里，绣工飞针走线，以彩丝成纹；井灶公廨旁，井户汲卤入锅，日夜煎盐。
关市券所收存契书，纸坊供应驿券与画样；茶马交割场前，商人把茶砖束紧，等候越岭的马队。
[/quote]

蜀绣、井盐、蜀纸与边茶作为本模组新增的四种特色产物，进入各地市场。府第、寺院与市镇各有采办，绣坊描样要纸，茶货包装也要纸。一处工坊开张，便有别处的货物循路而来。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17248598049921642797/CC815DB2974E21200EAC7C7C8E53F360C2B0D34C/[/img]

[h2]传习有序，地方各有成法[/h2]

匠师交换器样，官学收录簿册，向导重勘山程。旧日经验写入课题，后来者便能接续前人的经营。

[list]
[*][b]地区分支：[/b] 特色革新列入前两个时代的原版革新树，逐级开出地区分支，连接文化、社会、产业与军制。各府先传习本圈成法，再循前置课题与地方实践深究。
[*][b]客籍议约：[/b] 若想经营别圈名产，须先取得当地直属土地，研习「统一度量」与「匠人互访」，采用「乡社议办」，待义气达到60后订立客籍议约。议约接通当地机构与基础生产，深一层的地区课题仍留给本圈。
[*][b]吞并与承继：[/b] 整国吞并后，新主人承继被吞并国所属圈及其已取得产业资格所对应的基础生产与建造权限，既有工坊可接续经营。单独割让土地不授予这份资格；建筑地域限制、原料与雇佣要求仍适用，高级配方与特色军制仍须另行取得。
[/list]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10319446776780690249/000976E25C00F69C808B7188D1F9B68F723C2960/[/img]

[h2]地方事业，因地兴办[/h2]

地方事业是本模组的特色经营玩法。全国筹办与地方经营各有候选，你可以选择适合本府的事业，安排投入，在不断变化的项目中经营产业、改善乡里。革新与产业的进展，也会带来新的选择。

成果可能是新户迁入、营造改善，也可能是人才与文艺。你可以亲自作出取舍，或设定预算交由自动筹办；完工后验收实际收获，并为会盟积累贡献。

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17081046204220806931/8FA70E3DC510F72C5D045BA58F2860EB5B0E5619/[/img]

[h2]长路与新乡[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]七圈长线：[/b] 山中留下黑白足迹，井口露出陌生的巨骨，峡江船夫把暗礁刻进滩记。七圈各有一条约四十五年的地方长线；历次抉择将导向两种不同的长期章程，你也可以中途停止投入。
[*][b]湖广填四川：[/b] 沿江入蜀的船带来种子、手艺与旧乡的信。十章铺开约五十年：为来人开簿、分田、授徒，还是守住旧户的名额与礼序，将留下不同的新乡。
[*][b]百态短章：[/b] 独立故事与短链分布在各府。威望、阶层满意度、识字、研究、疾病、粮食、贸易与军备，各有眼前得失；十四幅共享插图之外，分支画面随故事推进而更换。
[/list]

[h2]开始游玩[/h2]

[list]
[*]适配EU5 1.4.*，建议单独启用；0.4.0 建议新开1337年存档。
[*]在巴蜀选择诸侯，从原版革新树、建设与招募界面开始经营；地方事业从屏幕右下角独立入口打开，自动筹办可在「自动操作→经济」中设置。
[*]同圈诸侯开局共同防卫；统治者拥有配偶与随机后代。盟约与家族，都会陪你走入后来的年月。
[/list]

[h2]0.4.0 更新[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]地方事业重制：[/b] 新增独立项目面板，全国筹办与地方经营并列展示，每轮选择一项，安排少量或大量投入。候选到期自动更换，进行中的项目显示预计完成日期；右下角圆形入口与顶部提示方便查看。
[*][b]自动筹办：[/b] 接入「自动操作→经济」，可设置保留国库、年度预算与役负上限。AI分为积极和审慎两种倾向，仅在有可做项目时每月判断一次，分别以70%和40%的概率开工。
[*][b]革新与建筑：[/b] 第二时代革新解锁大量投入、地区候选刷新及地区事业收益加成；行会传习接入专属项目。新增公共茶馆及其解锁革新，帮助减轻每月役负并促进人口同化。
[*][b]会盟与派系：[/b] 项目完工按投入和成果计入本届贡献，支持小数分数，并可在成员悬浮提示中查看构成。开局川东偏向兴业、川西偏向共建，避免首次分派反复弹出换派通知。
[*][b]旧内容清理：[/b] 退役七种旧地方事业资源，清理重复决议、失效事件及遗留状态；统一词条称呼，简化布尔修正说明与圈属条件，修正多余空格、异常换行和不存在的修正移除提示。
[*][b]界面与图文：[/b] 完善项目卡片、投入切换、自动状态齿轮、地区刷新按钮及完工通知设置；新增地方事业宣传图，更新地图与革新展示图，修复重复构建时的登记与本地化问题。
[/list]

english.title: Holy Bashu Empire
english.description:
[h1]Seven Circles, Thirty-Six Principalities[/h1]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10089394321281458581/F83AA0978D2C5F5CDC9951FA112EC7774E21A0AB/[/img]

Spring rain had broken the plank roads north of Sichuan. The first urgent dispatch to Chengdu came from Hanzhou: a new upstream weir had diverted the water, and the fields below could wait no longer.

Envoys from thirty-six prefectures gathered beside the Jin River. Salt merchants brought their accounts; pass wardens, their grain arrears. The head of a tea caravan laid a worn horse bell on the table. They renewed their compact, elected a common ruler and divided the realm into seven circles.

Chengdu kept the imperial seal. Grain, trade routes and military service still had to be agreed with each prefecture. The day after the compact was sealed, Hanzhou's envoy stood outside the magistrate's hall, waiting for the upstream gates to open.

Your next hundred years begin with that unfinished water dispute.

[h2]Choose a Principality[/h2]

Seven imperial circles and thirty-six playable principalities cover 164 locations. Tend the fields along the Jin River, manage southern salt wells, hold a northern pass, or guide tea caravans through the western valleys.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/9902154446628851737/2EA1F6F45E7F761231D2AF9AEC918457A14FDAEE/[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Bashu history and traditions.[/b] Dujiangyan irrigation, Wen Weng's schools, Shu brocade, Song-era salt wells and tea-horse trade inform local backgrounds, events and advances. The empire and its seven-circle constitution are alternate history rooted in Sichuan's geography.
[*][b]A century of regional development.[/b] Unique advances, flavour events and national decisions connect industry, communities and military institutions. Choices carry through branching stories to their conclusions.
[*][b]Buildings and troops.[/b] Regional buildings, production methods and nine unique unit types bring workshops, schools, granaries and garrisons into your economy.
[*][b]Unite the prefectures.[/b] Control the heartland to pursue Shu, Yu or the Bashu Empire through the native Formable tab or national decisions. Each has a new flag; regional advances and compacts continue under the new banner.
[/list]

[h2]Goods from Sichuan[/h2]

Embroiderers work at the Brocade Academy while salt workers draw brine beside the Well-Salt Office. Paper workshops supply contracts and patterns. At the Tea-Horse Exchange, merchants bind tea bricks for the mountain road.

Shu Embroidery, Well Salt, Shu Paper and Border Tea are four specialty goods added by this mod. They enter local markets, supplying households, temples and towns. Embroidery patterns and tea packaging also link paper-making to other industries.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17248598049921642797/CC815DB2974E21200EAC7C7C8E53F360C2B0D34C/[/img]

[h2]Local Knowledge, Lasting Institutions[/h2]

Artisans exchange patterns, scholars preserve accounts and guides survey mountain paths. Advances let later generations build on that knowledge.

[list]
[*][b]Regional branches.[/b] Unique advances branch from the native advances tree across the first two ages, linking culture, society, production and military organisation. Each principality begins with its own circle's traditions.
[*][b]Guest compacts.[/b] To produce another circle's specialties, own land there, research Common Measures and Craftsmen Exchanges, adopt Communal Deliberation and reach 60 Yiqi before signing a guest compact. This opens local institutions and basic production; advanced regional advances remain with their home circle.
[*][b]Annexation and inheritance.[/b] Full annexation inherits basic production and construction permissions from the target's regional industry access. Partial land transfers do not. Geography, inputs and staffing still matter; advanced recipes and unique military access remain separate.
[/list]

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/10319446776780690249/000976E25C00F69C808B7188D1F9B68F723C2960/[/img]

[h2]Local Affairs: Projects for Your Principality[/h2]

Local Affairs is this mod's distinctive development system. National and local projects offer changing opportunities: choose an undertaking, decide how much to invest, and develop your industries and communities. Advances and industrial development open further options.

Results may bring new households, improved infrastructure, talented courtiers or works of art. Make the choices yourself, or set a budget for automation. Receive a report of the actual outcome on completion and earn contribution towards the imperial feast.

[img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/17081046204220806931/8FA70E3DC510F72C5D045BA58F2860EB5B0E5619/[/img]

[h2]Long Roads and New Homes[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Seven regional stories.[/b] Black-and-white tracks appear in bamboo, strange bones emerge from a salt well, and river pilots record hidden reefs. Each circle has a story spanning about forty-five years, with two lasting settlements shaped by your choices. You may also end an undertaking early.
[*][b]Migration from Huguang.[/b] Boats bring seeds, craft skills and letters from home. Ten chapters unfold over about fifty years: admit new households and apprentices, or protect the claims and customs of established residents.
[*][b]Everyday choices.[/b] Independent stories and short chains touch prestige, estates, literacy, research, disease, food, commerce and military supply. Shared paintings and branch scenes accompany their progress.
[/list]

[h2]Starting a Campaign[/h2]

[list]
[*]For EU5 1.4.*. Enable this mod on its own. A new 1337 campaign is recommended for 0.4.0.
[*]Choose a Sichuan principality and use the native advances, construction and recruitment screens. Open Local Affairs from its separate bottom-right button; configure automation under Automation > Economy.
[*]Circle members begin with mutual defence. Opening rulers have spouses and a random number of children.
[*]This Workshop description is available in English. In-game prose is primarily Simplified Chinese; gallery images retain Chinese captions.
[/list]

[h2]0.4.0 Update[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Local Affairs redesigned.[/b] A separate panel presents national and local project cards. Choose one per round and select a small or large investment. Offers expire and refresh; active cards show estimated completion dates.
[*][b]Automation.[/b] Economy automation supports treasury reserves, annual budgets and burden limits. Active and cautious AI personalities attempt eligible projects once per month, with 70% and 40% participation chances.
[*][b]Advances and buildings.[/b] Second-age advances unlock large investment, local offer refreshes and stronger local rewards. Guild teaching opens specialist projects. The new public teahouse reduces monthly labor burden and promotes assimilation.
[*][b]Feast and factions.[/b] Completed projects grant fractional contribution, with a breakdown on member tooltips. Eastern and western opening faction preferences no longer cause repeated initial switch notifications.
[*][b]Cleanup and presentation.[/b] Retire seven legacy resources and obsolete decisions, events and states. Clarify terminology and permissions; fix spacing, line breaks and redundant modifier-removal messages. Improve cards, investment controls, status gears, refresh buttons and completion notification settings; refresh Workshop artwork and repeated-build handling.
[/list]

[*][b]湖广填四川：[/b] 沿江入蜀的船带来种子、手艺与旧乡的信。十章铺开约五十年：为来人开簿、分田、授徒，还是守住旧户的名额与礼序，将留下不同的新乡。
[*][b]百态短章：[/b] 独立故事与短链分布在各府。威望、阶层满意度、识字、研究、疾病、粮食、贸易与军备，各有眼前得失；十四幅共享插图之外，分支画面随故事推进而更换。
[/list]

[h2]开始游玩[/h2]

[list]
[*]适配EU5 1.4.*，建议单独启用；0.4.0 建议新开1337年存档。
[*]在巴蜀选择诸侯，从原版革新树、建设与招募界面开始经营；地方事业从屏幕右下角独立入口打开，自动筹办可在「自动操作→经济」中设置。
[*]同圈诸侯开局共同防卫；统治者拥有配偶与随机后代。盟约与家族，都会陪你走入后来的年月。
[/list]

[h2]0.4.0 更新[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]地方事业重制：[/b] 新增独立项目面板，全国筹办与地方经营并列展示，每轮选择一项，安排少量或大量投入。候选到期自动更换，进行中的项目显示预计完成日期；右下角圆形入口与顶部提示方便查看。
[*][b]自动筹办：[/b] 接入「自动操作→经济」，可设置保留国库、年度预算与役负上限。AI分为积极和审慎两种倾向，仅在有可做项目时每月判断一次，分别以70%和40%的概率开工。
[*][b]革新与建筑：[/b] 第二时代革新解锁大量投入、地区候选刷新及地区事业收益加成；行会传习接入专属项目。新增公共茶馆及其解锁革新，帮助减轻每月役负并促进人口同化。
[*][b]会盟与派系：[/b] 项目完工按投入和成果计入本届贡献，支持小数分数，并可在成员悬浮提示中查看构成。开局川东偏向兴业、川西偏向共建，避免首次分派反复弹出换派通知。
[*][b]旧内容清理：[/b] 退役七种旧地方事业资源，清理重复决议、失效事件及遗留状态；统一词条称呼，简化布尔修正说明与圈属条件，修正多余空格、异常换行和不存在的修正移除提示。
[*][b]界面与图文：[/b] 完善项目卡片、投入切换、自动状态齿轮、地区刷新按钮及完工通知设置；新增地方事业宣传图，更新地图与革新展示图，修复重复构建时的登记与本地化问题。
[/list]
